prds.title: Tasks & Projects requirements
prds.problem: Build a note-backed task workspace linked to project records.

prds.nonGoals:
Implement task updates and relationship persistence

prds.notes: All requirements are designed, not implemented or verified.

requirements.title: Task list
requirements.acceptance: Given the task list surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Task details
requirements.acceptance: Given the task details surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Project overview
requirements.acceptance: Given the project overview surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Native lifecycle and data safety
requirements.acceptance: Given the plugin is enabled then disabled, all subscriptions, timers and UI resources are released; no unrelated notes or settings are changed.

requirements.title: Isolated acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Given an isolated development vault and synthetic data, verify the intended outcome with a failing test before implementing it. Scaffold tests and synthetic examples do not satisfy this acceptance.

notes:
# Starter scope

Task list, task detail and project overview
Task and project entities with a declared relationship
Typed status/date fields, fixture list and acceptance TODOs

## Implementation work

Implement task updates and relationship persistence
Add recurrence, drag-and-drop or reminders only as needed

No business acceptance has passed. Use a separate development vault. Never insert credentials in this portable JSON.
Canonical native entity keys starter-task and starter-project avoid collision with the retained framework example repositories. User-facing Task/Project names and navigation remain unchanged.
